name: Aim
description: A full-turn setup spent steadying the shot instead of firing at once. It is activated as a full-turn maneuver instead of making a normal attack. In play, it grants advantage on the next legal attack, and creates the aimed effect.

name: Assassinate

requirements.text: Hidden

description: A hidden killing stroke meant to end the fight before the target can properly react. It is declared before an attack is resolved. In play, it adds 1 multiplier die. It requires Subterfuge Stealth 2; Hidden.

name: Brace Firearm
description: A prepared firing stance that settles a braced firearm for a steadier and more punishing shot. It is activated as a full-turn maneuver instead of making a normal attack. In play, it adds 1 multiplier die, and creates the braced effect. It requires a weapon with bracing.

name: Break Armor
description: A punishing follow-through aimed at exploiting armor strain after a solid hit. It is spent after a successful attack in the post-maneuver window. In play, it adds damage based on the defender's Shield 1 result. It requires Combat Melee 3; a weapon with armor breaking. At the cost of one Critical point.

name: Bull Charge

requirements.text: Unmounted, melee weapon, moved at least 3 squares before attack

description: A rushing impact that turns momentum into a heavier unmounted melee attack. It is declared before an attack is resolved. In play, it adds 1 multiplier die, and adds 1 risk die. It requires Combat Melee 3; Unmounted, melee weapon, moved at least 3 squares before attack.

name: Core Restore
description: A moment seized after a telling blow to recover spent effort. It is spent after a successful attack in the post-maneuver window. In play, it recovers 1 Core point. At the cost of 2 critical points.

name: Charge

requirements.text: Mounted and moved at least 3 squares before attack

description: A mounted driving attack that turns speed and weight into immediate offensive force. It is declared before an attack is resolved. In play, it adds 1 main die, adds 1 multiplier die, and adds 1 risk die. It requires Combat Melee 2, Outdoor Riding 2; Mounted and moved at least 3 squares before attack.

name: Choke

requirements.text: Target already locked

description: A tightening control hold that shifts a lock into a suffocating restraint. It is spent after a successful attack in the post-maneuver window. In play, it upgrades the target's condition to choking hold. It requires Combat Unarmed 2; Target already locked. At the cost of one Critical point.

name: Desperate Defense
description: A last-ditch defense that throws caution aside just to spoil the worst of an incoming blow. It is used as a reaction when attacked. In play, it cancels 1 incoming multiplier die.

name: Disarm
description: A practiced weapon-stripping stunt that sends the enemy's armament flying free. It is spent after a successful attack in the post-maneuver window. In play, it can disarm the target's weapon, and throws a dropped weapon up to 2 squares away. It requires Combat Melee 2 or Combat Unarmed 2; a weapon with disarming. At the cost of 2 critical points.

name: Disengage
description: A careful withdrawal that breaks contact without inviting the usual reaction strike. It is activated as a full-turn maneuver instead of making a normal attack. In play, it ignores movement-triggered reactions.

name: Evade

requirements.text: Cannot be used in medium or heavy armor, while locked, or while prone

description: A sudden bodily avoidance that tries to slip the attack rather than meet it with steel or shield. It is used as a reaction when attacked. In play, it removes 1 incoming multiplier die. It requires Cannot be used in medium or heavy armor, while locked, or while prone.

name: Formation

requirements.text: Adjacent ally also has access to Formation

description: A disciplined group attack in which nearby fighters support one another's line and pressure. It is declared before an attack is resolved. In play, it builds advantage from each participating ally in formation. It requires Combat Melee 2; a weapon with tactical; Adjacent ally also has access to Formation.

name: Hook
description: A controlling hooked follow-up meant to drag, trip, pull, or unseat the target after a telling hit. It is spent after a successful attack in the post-maneuver window. In play, it creates a tactical advantage or restriction that should be resolved according to its timing, tags, and listed requirements. It requires Combat Melee 2; a weapon with hooking. At the cost of 2 critical points.

name: Lock
description: A controlling hold that ties up the target's body and leaves them easier to dominate. It is spent after a successful attack in the post-maneuver window. In play, it applies the locked condition. It requires Combat Unarmed 1; a weapon with control. At the cost of one Critical point.

name: Lock And Strike

requirements.text: Target already locked

description: A brutal close-control sequence that turns an existing lock into a heavier strike and follow-up. It is declared before an attack is resolved. In play, it adds 2 main dies, and creates a follow-up safe attack. It requires Combat Unarmed 2; a weapon with control; Target already locked.

name: Opportunity Strike

requirements.text: Any equipped weapon

description: A fast answer against movement through your reach, meant to punish careless steps. It is used as a reaction when a target crosses your threat zone. In play, it creates a follow-up safe attack. It requires Any equipped weapon.

name: Parry
description: A committed weapon defense that turns an incoming blow aside rather than simply enduring it. It is used as a reaction when attacked. In play, it adds 1 armor die to the defense. It requires Combat Melee 2; a weapon with parrying.

name: Point Blank
description: A dangerous close-range firearm technique used when there is no time to yield space first. It is declared before an attack is resolved. In play, it adds 1 multiplier die, adds 1 risk die, and allows a firearm attack at melee range. It requires Combat Firearms 1; a weapon with point blank.

name: Press
description: A forward-driving attack that keeps pressure on a hurt or shaken target and crowds out their escape. It is declared before an attack is resolved. In play, it moves you 1 square toward the target if damage is dealt, and prevents the target from using Disengage. It requires Combat Melee 2.

name: Quick Reload
description: A hurried reload performed under pressure to keep a missile weapon in the fight. It is used in the moment its combat window allows. In play, it reduces reload time by 1. It requires Combat Firearms 2 or Combat Ranged 2; a weapon with reloading.

name: Receive Charge
description: A disciplined answer to an incoming charge, turning the enemy's rush into your own prepared opening. It is used as a reaction when a charge is declared. In play, it adds 1 multiplier die, and creates a follow-up safe attack. It requires Combat Melee 2; a weapon with receiving.

name: Redouble

requirements.skill: Combat Melee 2 or Combat Ranged 2 or Combat Unarmed 2

description: A fast follow-through that converts momentum or opening into another safe attack. It is spent after a successful attack in the post-maneuver window. In play, it adds 1 disadvantage, and creates a follow-up safe attack. It requires Combat Melee 2 or Combat Ranged 2 or Combat Unarmed 2; a weapon with fast. At the cost of one Critical point.

name: Reload
description: A full-turn action spent bringing a reloading weapon back into fighting condition. It is activated as a full-turn maneuver instead of making a normal attack. In play, it reduces reload time by 1. It requires a weapon with reloading.

name: Resist Hooking
description: A forceful reaction that resists being tripped, pulled, or unhorsed by a hooking attack. It is used as a reaction when a hooking effect is applied. In play, it creates a tactical advantage or restriction that should be resolved according to its timing, tags, and listed requirements. It requires Strength Athletics 1.

name: Riposte
description: A trained return strike launched the moment an enemy's failed attack leaves them exposed. It is used as a reaction after an attack fails to deal damage. In play, it creates a follow-up safe attack. It requires Combat Melee 3; a weapon with fast.

name: Sap

requirements.text: Hidden

description: A hidden nonlethal strike aimed at dropping a target before they can properly answer. It is declared before an attack is resolved. In play, it creates a tactical advantage or restriction that should be resolved according to its timing, tags, and listed requirements. It requires Subterfuge Stealth 1; Hidden.

name: Shield
description: A shield-led defense that absorbs the force of an incoming attack behind solid coverage. It is used in the moment its combat window allows. In play, it adds 2 armor dies to the defense. It requires Combat Melee 1; a weapon with shield.

name: Shield Wall

requirements.text: Adjacent ally also has access to Shield Wall

description: A shield-based group defense that strengthens the line when fighters hold together. It is used in the moment its combat window allows. In play, it grants 1 defense advantage, and adds 1 armor die when an adjacent ally also holds Shield Wall. It requires Tactics; a weapon with shield; Adjacent ally also has access to Shield Wall.

name: Suppressing Fire
description: A full-turn hail of shots used to pin enemies down and restrict their movement through a threatened space. It is activated as a full-turn maneuver instead of making a normal attack. In play, it uses the weapon's maximum range, and creates the suppressing fire battlefield effect. It requires Combat Ranged 3 or Combat Firearms 3; the firearm and ranged weapon groups.

name: Throw
description: A grappling finish that hurls the target down and leaves them prone at your feet. It is spent after a successful attack in the post-maneuver window. In play, it places the target adjacent to you, and applies the prone condition. It requires Combat Unarmed 3; a weapon with control. At the cost of 2 critical points.

name: Turn
description: A positional follow-up that twists the target and spoils their facing after contact. It is spent after a successful attack in the post-maneuver window. In play, it rotates the target 1 facing step. It requires Combat Melee 2. At the cost of one Critical point.

name: Quick Draw
description: A snap draw that brings a sidearm to bear in the same breath as the attack. It is declared before an attack is resolved. In play, it readies an equipped sidearm for immediate use, and lets that sidearm be used in the current action. It requires Combat Melee 1 or Combat Firearms 1; the sidearm groups.

name: Overwatch
description: A held ready stance that watches a field of fire for a target to punish. It is activated as a full-turn maneuver instead of making a normal attack. In play, it adds 1 main die, and creates the overwatch effect. It requires Combat Ranged 3 or Combat Firearms 3; the firearm and ranged weapon groups.

name: Convert
description: A direct conversion of critical advantage into immediate extra harm. It is spent after a successful attack in the post-maneuver window. In play, it converts every critical point from the attack into 1 damage each. It requires Combat Melee 1. At the cost of the attack's Critical points.

name: Half-Sword
description: A close-in rigid-blade technique that sacrifices ease to exploit gaps in armor. It is declared before an attack is resolved. In play, it adds 1 disadvantage, and ignores the target's highest armor die. It requires Combat Melee 3; a weapon with rigid blade.

name: Push Of Pike

requirements.text: Adjacent ally also wields a polearm or spear

description: A polearm follow-up that shoves the target backward under united reach and pressure. It is spent after a successful attack in the post-maneuver window. In play, it pushes the target 1 square. It requires Combat Melee 2; the polearm groups; Adjacent ally also wields a polearm or spear. At the cost of one Critical point.

name: Flank

requirements.text: One ally also threatens the target from another side

description: A positional attack that turns divided pressure on the target into a sharper melee opening. It is declared before an attack is resolved. In play, it adds 1 multiplier die. It requires Combat Melee 2; One ally also threatens the target from another side.

name: Hold At Bay
description: A long-weapon stop that arrests an enemy the moment they push into your reach. It is used as a reaction when a target crosses your threat zone. In play, it stops an entering target in the entered square. It requires Combat Melee 2; the polearm and spear groups.

name: Guard Ally

requirements.text: Adjacent ally is the target of the attack

description: A protective intervention that lets you cover an adjacent ally with your own shield and presence. It is used in the moment its combat window allows. In play, it adds 1 armor die to an adjacent ally's defense. It requires Combat Melee 1 or Tactics; a weapon with shield; Adjacent ally is the target of the attack.

name: Advance Under Guard
description: A guarded advance that trades stamina for safer forward movement behind shield work. It is activated as a full-turn maneuver instead of making a normal attack. In play, it adds 2 squares of movement, and ignores opportunity strikes during the move. It requires Combat Melee 2 or Tactics; a weapon with shield.

name: Grapple Break
description: A violent effort to wrench free from a lock or choking hold and possibly answer in the same beat. It triggers the instant you break free of a hold. In play, it grants advantage on your next attack. It requires Combat Unarmed 1 or Strength Athletics 2.

name: Shield Bash
description: A shield-led strike meant to stagger and drive the target backward if it lands cleanly. It is used in the moment its combat window allows. In play, it pushes the target 1 square if the attack deals damage. It requires Combat Melee 2; a weapon with shield.

name: Pounce

requirements.text: Quadruped body; moved at least 2 squares before the attack.

description: A leaping natural-weapon attack that uses movement to bowl the prey down under sudden force. It is declared before an attack is resolved. In play, it adds 1 multiplier die, and applies the prone condition. It requires a weapon with natural; Quadruped body; moved at least 2 squares before the attack.

name: Trample

requirements.text: Massive size; moves through creatures at least one size smaller.

description: A massive rushing movement that batters through smaller creatures and throws them down. It is declared before movement is resolved. In play, it applies the prone condition, lets the attacker pass through smaller creatures, and applies natural-weapon damage to each affected creature. It requires Massive size; moves through creatures at least one size smaller.

name: Tail Sweep

requirements.text: Heavy or long tail; affects creatures behind the actor.

description: A broad tail-driven attack that clears space behind the creature with brute control. It is declared before an attack is resolved. In play, it applies prone if the attack deals damage, and strikes across the rear arc adjacent. It requires Heavy or long tail; affects creatures behind the actor.

name: Constrict

requirements.text: Coiling body part — tentacles, serpentine torso.

description: A crushing coil or binding grip that turns a hit into an ongoing grapple and squeeze. It is spent after a successful attack in the post-maneuver window. In play, it applies the grappled condition, and starts ongoing damage of 1d3 per turn. It requires a weapon with natural; Coiling body part — tentacles, serpentine torso. At the cost of 2 critical points.

name: Swallow Whole

requirements.text: Apex predator with a maw — target must be much smaller or already grappled.

description: A monstrous finishing attack that devours a much smaller or already controlled target. It is spent after a successful attack in the post-maneuver window. In play, it can swallow the target whole, and starts ongoing damage of 1d6 per turn. It requires a weapon with bite; Apex predator with a maw — target must be much smaller or already grappled. At the cost of 3 critical points.

name: Wing Buffet

requirements.text: Wings broad enough to drive air with force.

description: A heavy wing-driven strike that knocks a target back or down under forceful air and impact. It is declared before an attack is resolved. In play, it pushes the target 2 squares if the attack deals damage, and applies prone if the attack deals damage. It requires Wings broad enough to drive air with force.

name: Arced Shot

requirements.text: An arc-capable weapon (a bow, sling, or thrown weapon, never a firearm) with overhead clearance for the arc; the GM may forbid it indoors or under cover

description: A lobbed, indirect shot that arcs over anything in the way to fall on the target. It is declared before an attack is resolved. In play, it adds 1 risk die, and arcs over intervening cover to strike indirectly. It requires Combat Ranged 1 or Combat Thrown 1; the ranged weapon and thrown weapon groups; An arc-capable weapon (a bow, sling, or thrown weapon, never a firearm) with overhead clearance for the arc; the GM may forbid it indoors or under cover.

name: Break Grapple
description: A twisting effort to slip free of a grapple. It is used to break free of a condition that holds you. In play, it is resolved as an opposed dexterity check, and removes the grappled condition.

name: Slip The Lock
description: A forceful wrench to free a limb from a joint-lock. It is used to break free of a condition that holds you. In play, it is resolved as an opposed strength check, and removes the locked condition.

name: Break The Choke
description: A desperate wrench to tear a choking hold off your throat. It is used to break free of a condition that holds you. In play, it is resolved as an opposed strength check, and removes the choking hold condition.

name: Stand Up
description: A quick rise back to your feet from prone. It is used to break free of a condition that holds you. In play, it removes the prone condition.

name: Core Attack
description: A raw exertion of effort that drives any attack harder. It is declared before an attack is resolved. In play, it adds 1 multiplier die. At the cost of one Core point.

name: Core Speed
description: A burst of raw effort that carries you twice as far. It is declared before movement is resolved. In play, it doubles your movement. At the cost of one Core point.

name: Core Escape
description: A surge of raw effort that wrenches you free of every hold at once. It is used to break free of a condition that holds you. In play, it removes every one of grappled, locked, and choking hold you are under. At the cost of one Core point.

name: Core Toughness
description: A bracing of the body that lets you shrug off part of a blow. It is used as a reaction after taking damage. In play, it reduces damage taken by 1. At the cost of one Core point.

name: Core Defense
description: A committed defensive effort that hardens your guard against a blow. It is used as a reaction when attacked. In play, it adds 1 multiplier die to the defense. At the cost of one Core point.
